commonDiseases.symptoms: Small white spots with deep purple borders on strawberry leaflets.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High humidity and overhead sprinkler wetting.

commonDiseases.name: Powdery Mildew (Podosphaera aphanis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Upward curling of leaf margins with white powdery coating on leaf undersides and young fruit.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Dry warm days and cool humid nights.

generalPrevention: Plant on silver-black plastic mulch to completely prevent fruit contact with wet soil.
Drench bio-agent Trichoderma at planting to prevent crown root rot.
Use premier varieties: Sweet Charlie, Camarosa, Winter Dawn, or Rania.
Spray bio-fungicide Bacillus subtilis or Fenhexamid for grey mold control.

name: Papaya (Red Lady 786)
maharashtraRegion: Khandesh (Nandurbar, Jalgaon, Dhule), Pune, Sangli, Solapur, Marathwada
description: High-yielding gynodioecious hybrid producing thick, sweet, deep red-orange flesh with high sugar content (13° Brix) and robust transport shelf life.
waterRequirement: 1,200 - 1,500 mm through drip; zero water stagnation.
soilPreference: Deep, rich, friable sandy loam or medium black soil with phenomenal drainage, pH 6.5 - 7.2.

growthStages.description: 60-day seedlings planted on raised mounds.
Rapid hollow stem elongation; self-fertile bisexual and female blossoms in leaf axils.
Cylindrical heavy fruits crowd upper trunk below leaf canopy.
Picked when yellow color breaks at blossom end.

commonDiseases.name: Papaya Ring Spot Virus (PRSV)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Yellow mosaic mottling on leaves, severe shoe-string leaf distortion, dark green water-soaked oily rings on fruit rind and petioles; aphid vector.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High aphid activity during post-monsoon and early summer.

commonDiseases.name: Collar Rot / Stem Rot (Pythium aphanidermatum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Water-soaked soft rotting at soil line causing top-heavy tree to topple over.

generalPrevention: Plant border rows of barrier crops (maize or sorghum) to intercept PRSV aphid vectors.
Release parasitoid Acerophagus papayae to achieve 100% biological control of devastating Papaya mealybugs.
Plant on raised ridges to ensure irrigation water never touches tree trunk base.

name: Watermelon
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra (Pune, Solapur, Satara riverbeds), Marathwada, Khandesh
description: Thirst-quenching summer vine yielding heavy fruits with crisp, juicy, deep crimson flesh, high lycopene, and sweetness.
waterRequirement: 400 - 600 mm via drip fertigation on silver mulch.
soilPreference: Well-drained sandy loam or riverbed alluvium, pH 6.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Vigorous trailing vines spread across bed.
Yellow monoecious flowers; morning bee pollination critical.
Berries expand rapidly accumulating water and sugars.
Tendril near fruit dries completely; ground spot turns buttery yellow; dull thud sound on tapping.

commonDiseases.name: Fusarium Wilt
commonDiseases.symptoms: Vines wilt unilaterally; vascular browning.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: Angular yellow patches on leaves.

generalPrevention: Use popular icebox hybrids: Sugar Baby, Kiran, Max, or Saraswati.
Install methyl eugenol traps for fruit fly control.

name: Muskmelon (Kharbuj)
maharashtraRegion: Pune, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Marathwada
description: Aromatic ribbed melon with sweet succulent orange/salmon pulp and intoxicating dessert fragrance.

growthStages.description: Rapid vine growth.
Bee pollination.
Corky net pattern develops on rind.
Stem separates cleanly from fruit upon gentle pressure.

commonDiseases.name: Powdery Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: White coating.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: Yellow leaf spots.

generalPrevention: Use varieties: Madhuras, Hara Madhu, Kundan.

name: Sapota / Chikoo (Dahanu Gholvad)
maharashtraRegion: Palghar & Thane (Dahanu & Gholvad produce GI-tagged Chikoo), Konkan Coast
description: The GI-tagged coastal treasure of Maharashtra. Velvety golden-brown round fruits with exceptionally sweet, malty, granulated brown pulp shaped by coastal calcium-rich soils.
soilPreference: Deep coastal sandy alluvium and lateritic soils.

growthStages.description: Bell-shaped white flowers in leaf axils.
Slow fruit expansion accumulating milky latex.
Scratching skin reveals yellow-green flesh beneath brown scurf.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Spot (Phaeophleospora indica)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Circular brown spots with white center on leaves.

generalPrevention: Use renowned varieties: Kalipatti, Cricket Ball, or Murabba.
Clean brown scurf and wash fruits in water baths before boxing.

name: Cashew (Vengurla Kaju)
maharashtraRegion: South Konkan (Sindhudurg, Ratnagiri, Vengurla is Cashew Research hub), Goa
description: High-value coastal plantation crop holding GI status. Yields nutritious kidney-shaped cashew nuts and succulent aromatic cashew apples (used for feni).
waterRequirement: 1,500 - 2,500 mm; thrives rainfed on sloped hillocks.
soilPreference: Rocky red lateritic hill soils with good drainage.

growthStages.description: Pinkish new shoot flush.
Fragrant terminal panicles.
Grey kidney nut forms first; pedicel swells into red/yellow cashew apple.

commonDiseases.name: Dieback / Pink Disease
commonDiseases.symptoms: Twig withering.

commonPests: Cashew Stem and Root Borer (Plocaederus ferrugineus)
generalPrevention: Plant high-yielding Vengurla hybrids: V-4, V-7, V-8, or V-9.
Spray Lambda-cyhalothrin at vegetative flushing and flowering against tea mosquito bug.
Chisel out stem borer grubs from trunk base and paste with coal tar + kerosene.

name: Jackfruit (Phanas)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan Coast (Sindhudurg, Ratnagiri, Raigad), Western Ghats
description: World's largest tree-borne fruit. Distinctive spiky exterior; available as firm crunchy 'Kaapa' (कापा) and soft luscious 'Rasaal' (रसाळ) golden bulbs.

growthStages.description: Club-shaped spikes emerge directly from main tree trunk and heavy scaffold branches.
Spiky syncarp swells up to 10-25 kg.
Spines flatten; hollow drum sound when tapped; intoxicating fruity aroma.

commonDiseases.name: Rhizopus Fruit Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Soft black fungal whisker decay.

generalPrevention: Grow renowned Konkan varieties: Konkan Prolific, Sindhur, or Gumless.

name: Jamun (Indian Blackberry)
maharashtraRegion: Throughout Maharashtra & India, Konkan, Western Ghats
description: Sacred, medicinal purple fruit world-famous for controlling diabetes (jamboline glucoside) and purifying blood.
soilPreference: Deep alluvial soils and river banks.

growthStages.description: Fragrant greenish-white flowers.
Green oblong berries transition to pink then deep glossy purple.
Harvested fresh before monsoon.

commonDiseases.name: Anthracnose
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark fruit spots.

generalPrevention: Use large-fruited varieties like Bahadoli or Konkan Jamun.

name: Aonla (Indian Gooseberry)
maharashtraRegion: Ahmednagar, Pune, Marathwada, Central India
description: Revered Ayurvedic rasayana packed with 20 times more Vitamin C than oranges. Hardy tree thriving in drought and alkaline wastelands.

growthStages.description: Yellow flowers in leaf axils; embryonic dormancy.
Six-ribbed light green translucent berries expand.
Harvested for Chyawanprash, candy, and juice.

commonDiseases.name: Aonla Rust (Ravenelia emblicae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown pustules on fruit and leaves.

generalPrevention: Use high-yielding varieties: NA-7, Krishna, Kanchan, or Chakaiya.

name: Ber (Indian Jujube)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Solapur, Ahmednagar dry belts
description: The king of arid fruits. Thorny, drought-hardy tree producing crisp, sweet, apple-like golden-yellow fruits.

growthStages.description: Heavy annual heading back.
Small yellow flowers.
Crisp golden fruits picked.

commonDiseases.name: Powdery Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: White coating on fruit.

generalPrevention: Use Umran, Gola, or Mehrun varieties.

name: Tamarind (Chinch)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Western Maharashtra, South India
description: Long-lived majestic tree producing tart, pulp-rich brown pods indispensable in Indian sambar, rasam, and chutneys.

growthStages.description: Yellow streaked with red flowers.
Brittle shell cracks revealing sticky dark brown tangy pulp.

commonDiseases.name: Sooty Mold
commonDiseases.symptoms: Black leaf mold.

generalPrevention: Plant high-pulp grafted varieties: Pratishthan, PKM-1, or Yogeshwari.

name: Apple (Royal Delicious)
maharashtraRegion: Kashmir Valley, Himachal Pradesh (Shimla, Kullu), Uttarakhand
description: Premier temperate fruit of India requiring 800-1000 chilling hours below 7°C. Crisp, aromatic red dessert apple.

growthStages.description: Pink blossoms open.
Spur fruitlets form; thinning applied.
Deep red stripes develop.

commonDiseases.name: Apple Scab (Venturia inaequalis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and scabby deformed fruit.

commonDiseases.name: Powdery Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: White coating on terminal shoots.

generalPrevention: Prophylactic spray of Mancozeb or Difenoconazole at pink bud stage for scab prevention.

name: Golden Delicious Apple
maharashtraRegion: Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh
description: Sweet, juicy, honey-flavored golden-yellow dessert and culinary apple with smooth skin and exceptional aroma.

growthStages.description: White flowers.
Golden skin with sweet crisp flesh.

commonDiseases.name: Apple Scab
commonDiseases.symptoms: Scab lesions.

generalPrevention: Harvest carefully to avoid skin bruising.

name: Malta Sweet Orange
maharashtraRegion: Punjab, Rajasthan, UP, Himachal foothills
description: Tight-skinned sweet orange yielding dense aromatic orange juice with rich vitamin C.

growthStages.description: Spring blossom.
Golden orange globose fruit.

commonDiseases.name: Canker
commonDiseases.symptoms: Corky lesions.

generalPrevention: Spray copper fungicides before monsoon.

name: Pineapple (Kew / Queen)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Sindhudurg, Ratnagiri), Assam, Kerala, West Bengal
description: Spiky tropical bromeliad yielding giant aromatic golden syncarp rich in bromelain enzyme.
soilPreference: Acidic sandy loam with high organic matter, pH 4.5 - 5.5.

growthStages.description: Spiky rosette.
Ethephon applied into heart.
Base eyes turn golden yellow.

commonDiseases.name: Heart Rot (Phytophthora)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Central leaf rot.

generalPrevention: Dip suckers in Bordeaux mixture before planting.

name: Shahi Litchi
maharashtraRegion: Muzaffarpur (Bihar - GI tagged), Dehradun, Punjab
description: Exquisite translucent juicy aril with divine rose fragrance enclosed in rough pink-red leathery pericarp.
optimalTemp: 22°C - 34°C (requires mild cool winter without frost followed by warm dry spring)

growthStages.description: Apetalous panicles.
Rapid aril swelling.
Bright red clusters picked.

commonDiseases.name: Fruit Cracking
commonDiseases.symptoms: Pericarp splits.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Dry westerly winds followed by rain.

generalPrevention: Irrigate regularly during summer to prevent fruit cracking.

name: Dragon Fruit (Kamalam)
maharashtraRegion: Baramati (Pune), Solapur, Sangli, Gujarat, Marathwada
description: Climbing night-blooming cactus yielding exotic bright pink fruits with speckled white/red sweet pulp packed with antioxidants.
soilPreference: Well-drained sandy loam or gravelly soil; zero waterlogging.

growthStages.description: Triangular fleshy cladodes trained on cement poles with tire ring.
Giant fragrant white flowers bloom for one night.
Pink skin with green scales; picked firm.

commonDiseases.name: Stem Canker (Neoscytalidium dimidiatum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sunken yellow-orange spots turning into brown cankers.

generalPrevention: Spray copper hydroxide and prune infected stems.

name: Kokum (Ratamba)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg holding GI status), Western Ghats
description: Endemic Western Ghats fruit yielding ruby-red tangy rinds (amsul) for solkadhi, cooling summer sarbat, and kokum butter.

growthStages.description: Dioecious fleshy flowers.
Globose fruits turn deep dark purple; harvested fresh.

commonDiseases.name: Fruit Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Decay.

generalPrevention: Plant grafted varieties: Konkan Amruta or Konkan Hatis.

name: Karonda
maharashtraRegion: Konkan, Western Ghats wild forests, throughout Maharashtra
description: Hardy spiny shrub yielding white-pink berries that turn glossy black; beloved for sour pickles, chutneys, and raw forest snacking.

growthStages.description: Fragrant white starry blossoms.
Berry pickings for pickle or fresh.

commonDiseases.name: Anthracnose
commonDiseases.symptoms: Spotting.

generalPrevention: Use Konkan Bold variety.

name: Wood Apple (Kavath)
maharashtraRegion: Dry zones of Maharashtra, Marathwada, Western Ghat plateaus
description: Extremely hard woody spherical shell holding aromatic, astringent, brown sticky pulp made into famous Kavath Chutney and Murabba.

growthStages.description: Small dull red flowers.
Hard grey woody shells fall when ripe.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Spot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Specks.

generalPrevention: Virtually pest-free dryland fruit.

name: Phalsa
maharashtraRegion: North Maharashtra, Central India, Punjab
description: Small sweet-tart purple berries renowned for cooling sherbet and anti-heatstroke properties in blazing Indian summers.

growthStages.description: Cut back close to ground.
Tiny purple berries picked daily.

commonDiseases.name: Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Leaf spots.

generalPrevention: Prune in January to 1 meter height to trigger fresh fruiting shoots.

name: Bael (Golden Apple)
maharashtraRegion: Throughout India, forest tracts of Maharashtra
description: Sacred Shiva tree producing hard-shelled fruits with sweet, aromatic, mucilaginous orange pulp supreme for digestive health and sherbet.

growthStages.description: Fragrant blossoms.
Large globose fruit matures next summer.

commonDiseases.name: Fruit Canker
commonDiseases.symptoms: Shell lesions.

generalPrevention: Use improved varieties: Narendra Bael-5, Pant Aparna.

name: Passion Fruit
maharashtraRegion: Western Ghats (Mahabaleshwar, Ooty, Coorg), Northeast India
description: Vigorous climbing vine yielding aromatic purple/yellow fruits filled with intensely aromatic sweet-tart pulp and edible seeds.

growthStages.description: Trained on wire trellis.
Stunning purple flowers; fruit harvested when purple skin wrinkles slightly.

commonDiseases.name: Brown Spot (Alternaria passiflorae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sunken brown spots on fruit.

generalPrevention: Spray mancozeb for brown spot control.

name: Kiwi Fruit
maharashtraRegion: Arunachal Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Nilgiris
description: Temperate dioecious climbing vine producing brown fuzzy berries with vibrant green flesh and black seeds.

growthStages.description: Male and female vines cross-pollinated.
Hard fruits picked for controlled ripening.

commonDiseases.name: Root Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Wilting.

generalPrevention: Maintain 1:8 male to female vine ratio on pergolas.

name: Plum (Alubukhara)
maharashtraRegion: Himachal Pradesh, Kashmir, Nilgiris
description: Succulent drupe with smooth reddish-purple skin and juicy sweet-tart pulp with a single hard stone.

growthStages.description: White blossom canopy.
Picked firm for market.

commonDiseases.name: Brown Rot (Monilinia)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Fuzzy brown fruit decay.

generalPrevention: Spray captan before harvest.

name: Peach (Aadu)
maharashtraRegion: Punjab, Himachal, Uttarakhand foothills
description: Velvety fuzzy skin drupe with yellow-red blush and melting sweet aromatic flesh.

growthStages.description: Stunning pink flowers.
Handpicked.

commonDiseases.name: Peach Leaf Curl (Taphrina deformans)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Leaves thicken, pucker, and turn red-yellow.

generalPrevention: Apply lime sulfur spray during dormant bud swell.

name: Apricot (Khubani)
maharashtraRegion: Ladakh, Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh
description: Velvety golden-orange fruit famous for rich dietary fiber, vitamin A, and sun-dried Ladakhi Khubani.

growthStages.description: White flowers.
Golden fruits picked.

commonDiseases.name: Gummosis
commonDiseases.symptoms: Gum ooze.

generalPrevention: Use Halman or New Castle varieties.

name: Sweet Cherry
maharashtraRegion: Kashmir Valley, Himachal Pradesh
description: Exquisite glossy ruby-red heart-shaped fruit with sweet crisp flesh and green stem.

growthStages.description: Full white canopy.
Carefully hand-picked with stems.

commonDiseases.name: Fruit Cracking
commonDiseases.symptoms: Skin splits.

generalPrevention: Cover trees with plastic rain shelters during ripening.

name: Pear (Nashpati / Babgosh)
maharashtraRegion: Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Kashmir, Nilgiris
description: Crisp, sweet, gritty-textured fruit available as crisp stone-hard Desi Nashpati and melting soft European Babugosha.

growthStages.description: White flowers.
Harvested mature green.

commonDiseases.name: Fire Blight (Erwinia amylovora)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Blackened scorched shoots (shepherd's crook).

generalPrevention: Prune blighted twigs 30 cm below infection mark.

name: Date Palm (Khajur)
maharashtraRegion: Kutch (Gujarat), Rajasthan desert belts, arid Maharashtra
description: Desert king tree: 'feet in water and head in fire'. High energy sweet dates harvested fresh (Khelal) or soft dried.
optimalTemp: 28°C - 42°C (intense heat with zero rain during ripening)
soilPreference: Sandy desert soils, highly salt tolerant.

growthStages.description: Manual pollination of female spadix.
Crisp yellow/red dates harvested before monsoon.

commonDiseases.name: Graphiola Leaf Spot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Hard black pustules on fronds.

generalPrevention: Use tissue-cultured Barhee or Medjool varieties.

name: Star Fruit (Carambola / Kamrakh)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan, Western Ghats, South India
description: Five-angled translucent green-yellow fruit that reveals perfect star slices when cross-cut; crisp, tart-sweet and refreshing.

growthStages.description: Clusters on branches.
Turn glossy amber-yellow.

commonDiseases.name: Anthracnose
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown specks.

generalPrevention: Grow Arkin sweet variety.
